name: fusion-sleep
description: Fusion Sleep — sleep, relaxation and ambient sound app by Fusion Labs

scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/setup-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
